description:
Maps one or more protein identifiers to their corresponding STRING metadata, including:
gene symbol, description, sequence, domains, species, and internal STRING ID.

This method is useful for translating raw identifiers into readable, annotated protein entries.

Example input: "TP53%0dSMO"

proteins.description: One or more input protein identifiers (gene symbols, UniProt IDs, etc.), separated by carriage return (%0d).

show_sequence.description: Include sequences. Use only if the user requests sequence data.

species.description: NCBI taxonomy ID (e.g. 9606 for human) or STRING genome ID (e.g. STRG0AXXXXX for uploaded genomes).

name: string_resolve_proteins
title: STRING: Resolves protein identifiers to metadata
